verdict.rationale: HumanLayer creates tasks from Jira, GitHub and Linear issues and from a new-task composer. It also offers workflows (Oneshot, RPI, PRD-Oriented) that scale review and planning to how clear the change is, which implies plain-language intent can be shaped into a scoped piece of work. However, the evidence never explicitly shows a free-text description being automatically converted into a scoped implementation spec or plan. Missing for 10: explicit docs that plain-language input is automatically turned into a scoped task or plan, detail on what the RPI/PRD phases produce, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
